opencli: 1.0.0
info:
  title: Greeter
  version: 1.0.0
commands:
  greet:
    description: Read greeter.yaml in the working directory and print its greeting string verbatim, followed by a newline. The person argument identifies the recipient and does not interpolate or otherwise change the configured greeting. With loud omitted (false), the greeting is unchanged; with --loud, uppercase the greeting before printing and logging it. Each successful call emits one greeted log record on stderr with the supplied person and the exact greeting printed, without the trailing newline.
    parameters:
    - name: person
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: loud
      in: flag
      required: false
      schema:
        type: boolean
        default: false
    responses:
      '0':
        description: Greeting printed
      '1':
        description: Invalid input
  translate:
    description: Read the greeting string from greeter.yaml in the working directory, translate it into the language given by the language argument, and print the translated greeting, followed by a newline. Each successful call emits one greeted log record whose greeting is the translated greeting printed, without the trailing newline.
    parameters:
    - name: language
      in: argument
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    responses:
      '0':
        description: Greeting translated and printed
      '1':
        description: Invalid input
extensions:
  files:
    greeting-config:
      path: greeter.yaml
      format: YAML mapping with a greeting string; greet reads that string as literal text, without placeholders or person substitution
      access: read
  log_records:
    greeted:
      message: Greeting printed
      format: logfmt on stderr with person equal to the person argument and greeting equal to the printed greeting without its trailing newline
  outgoing_calls:
    notify:
      command: notifier
      arguments:
      - --person
      - '{person}'
